brief: A local Windows coding harness for independent developers, with visible plans, scoped permissions, verification and human review.
criteria: Readable H at 24px, simplified 16px favicon, one-colour form and a reusable motion signal.

concepts.name: Bridge
concepts.idea: Two stable rails joined by one stepped transfer.
rationale: The H identifies the harness without a terminal cliché.
The transfer path becomes the moving signal for task states.
Outline wordmark and filled-path symbol work without installed fonts.

recommendation: Bridge was selected by the user. Palette follows the supplied Vertex reference.
next_steps: Integrate the selected assets into the desktop app after implementation review.
Use static posters when motion is reduced.
